bio: Francesca Ferlaino was baptized at San Mango d'Aquino on 25 February 1797 as Francesca Angelina, daughter of Giuseppe Antonio Ferlaino and Rosa Gallo. On 26 February 1812, aged about fifteen, she married Rosario Iera, the marriage entry calling her Agostina. She was buried at San Mango on 3 February 1880, this time under the name Faustina, with her age given as 90 and her late husband as 'Joseph', probably a slip for Rosario, who was a son of Giuseppe. The run of different names across her records probably all belongs to one woman, but it has not been fully resolved. She was John's 5th-great-grandmother.
